questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

__Bulbul is honest girl__ but she is also very rude.
questions.solution:
The correct solution is option 1.

'an' and 'a' are definite articles whereas 'the' is an indefinite article.

'an' is used when the word starts with a vowel sound - that is, 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u' and 'a' is used for words starting with a consonant sound.

Here, 'honest', when pronounced, has a sound of 'o' which is a vowel. So, 'an' must be used before 'honest'.

The correct sentence is: *Bulbul is **an** honest girl but she is also very rude.*

questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

Had Rajani not taken / a cab to the station / she would have definitely / miss the train.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The grammatical error lies in the phrase "**miss the train**."
 
• The correct verb form should be "**missed**" to align with the conditional tense used earlier in the sentence.
 
• The sentence is in the past perfect conditional tense, which requires "**would have**" followed by the past participle of the verb.
 
• Thus, "**miss**" should be changed to "**missed**" for grammatical correctness.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Had Rajani not taken a cab to the station, she would have definitely **missed** the train."*

2084

questions.solution:
Arranging them in descending order of their ages,

Ashish is the second youngest and is 19 years old.

Daksh is between Kailash and Manish

Kailash > Daksh > Manish

Kailash is 42 years old and Ashish is 20 years younger than Daksh.

Ashish is 19, so Daksh is 39 and Ashish is second youngest

Kailash (42) > Daksh (39) > Manish > Ashish (19) >Lalit

‘Lalit’ is the youngest among all.

Hence, “Lalit” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the number that will replace the question mark.

 
 

 4
 16
 63
 
 

 7
 35
 ?
 
 

 8
 48
 287
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

Row wise operation.

**Divide the 2nd number by 1st number, the quotient we get is multiplied by 2nd number and then finally subtract 1 from it to get the 3rd number.**

For Row 1:

→ 16 ÷ 4 = 4

→ 4 × 16 = 64

→ 64 - 1 = 63

**For Row 2:**

**→ 35 ÷ 7 = 5**

**→ 5 × 35 = 175**

**→ 175 - 1 = 174**

For Row 3:

→ 48 ÷ 8 = 6

→ 6 × 48 = 288

→ 288 - 1 = 287

Hence, “**174**” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pans are jugs.

No plates are jugs.

**Conclusion:**

I: Some pans are plates.

II: Some jugs are pans.

III: No pans are plates.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusion I and III follows
Only conclusion II and III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c15c9f88aac6959dfee9390778fb84062d863d9e521d0cce4f5277cbb962b94.png] 

**Conclusions:**

1:Some pans are plates → False, as all pans are jugs and no plates are jugs.

2: Some jugs are pans → True, as all pans are jugs.

Conclusion 3: No pans are plates → True, as all pans are jugs and no plates are jugs.

Hence, “only conclusion 2 and 3” follow.

questions.question: A sum of Rs 5200 is divided amongst A, B, C, and D such that the ratio of shares of A and B is 2 : 3, that of B and C is 4 : 5 and that of C and D is 1 : 2. What is the difference between the shares of B and D?

**Given:**

The total sum of money = Rs. 5200

The ratio of the share of A and B = 2 ∶ 3

The ratio of the share of B and C = 4 ∶ 5

The ratio of the share of C and D = 1 ∶ 2

**Calculations:**

Simplifying the ratios to get the same unit by cross multiplication

Ratio of A and B = (2 ∶ 3) × 4

⇒ 8 ∶ 12

Ratio of B and C = (4 ∶ 5) × 3

⇒ 12 ∶ 15

Ratio of C and D = (1 ∶ 2) × 15

⇒ 15 ∶ 30

Ratio of A, B, C and D = 8 ∶ 12 ∶ 15 ∶ 30

Total sum = 8x + 12x + 15x + 30x

⇒ 65x = 5200

⇒ x = 80

Difference between the shares of B and D = 30x - 12x

⇒ 18 × 80

⇒ Rs. 1440

**∴ The difference between the shares of B and D is Rs. 1440**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to Rs 12096 at 8% p.a in 5(1)/(2) years at simple interest. What will be the simple interest on the same sum at 10% p.a in 8 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum amounts to Rs 12096 at 8% p.a in 5(1)/(2) years at simple interest.

Simple interest on the same sum at 10% p.a in 8 years

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × r × t)/100 

where P = Sum of money, r = Rate, and t = Time

**Calculation:**

A = 12096, t = 8% and time = 11/2

As we know,

⇒ A = P + (Prt/100)

⇒ 12096 = P + (P × 8 × 11)/(100 × 2)

⇒ 12096 = P + 11P/25

⇒ 36P/25 = 12096

⇒ P = 12096 × 25/36

⇒ P = 8400

Again,

⇒ P = 8400, t = 8 years and r = 10%

⇒ SI = Prt/100

⇒ SI = (8400 × 8 × 10)/100

⇒ SI = 6720

**Short Trick : **

Let principal be 100%

Rate for 1 year = 8%

Rate for 11/2 years = 8 × 11/2 = 44%

⇒ 144% = 12096

⇒ 100% = 12096/144 × 100

Now,

R = 10% and time = 8 years

Interest for 8 years = 80%

Simple interest = 12096/144 × 100 × 80

⇒ 6720

**∴ The simple interest will be 6720.**

questions.question: What is the area (in m²) of a triangular field whose sides measure 25 m, 39 m and 56 m?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a scalene triangle, the area can be calculated directly using Heron's formula.

Semi-perimeter (s) = (25 + 39 + 56) ÷ 2 = 120 ÷ 2 = 60 m.

Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Area = √[60 × (60 − 25) × (60 − 39) × (60 − 56)]

Area = √[60 × 35 × 21 × 4] = √[176400] = 420 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 420 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the triangular field:

a = 25 m

b = 39 m

c = 56 m

**Formula Used:**

Heron's Formula for the area of a triangle:

Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)]

Where, semi-perimeter s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/523f1946debf8239eebd6391ac53cf962bd6ce1194f2d2db325a30f519ba22af.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ s = (25 + 39 + 56) ÷ 2

⇒ s = 120 ÷ 2 = 60 m

⇒ Area = √[60 × (60 − 25) × (60 − 39) × (60 − 56)]

⇒ Area = √[60 × 35 × 21 × 4]

⇒ Area = √[(15 × 4) × (7 × 5) × (7 × 3) × 4]

Grouping the similar terms to find square roots:

⇒ Area = √[(4 × 4) × (7 × 7) × (15 × 5 × 3)]

⇒ Area = √[16 × 49 × 225]

⇒ Area = 4 × 7 × 15

⇒ Area = 420 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 420 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Equilateral Triangle

For a triangle with all three equal sides (a), Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a².

Area of Isosceles Triangle

For a triangle with two equal sides (a) and a base (b), Area = (b ÷ 4) × √(4a² − b²).

General Area of a Triangle

When the base length and the perpendicular vertical height are known, Area = (1 ÷ 2) × Base × Height.

questions.question: Who is the head of the State and is the highest formal authority in India?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is Option **3** i.e **__President__**.

 
• **President** is the **head of the state** and is the highest formal authority in the country.

 
 
• He is the **commander-in-chief of the Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• **Draupadi Murmu** is the present President of India.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister** is the **head of the government** and actually exercises all governmental powers.
 
 
• He takes most of the decisions in the Cabinet meetings.
 
 
 
• **Vice President** acts as **President** in the absence of the president due to **death, resignation, impeachment, or other situations**.
 
• **Vice President of India** is also **ex officio Chairperson** of the **Rajya Sabha.**
 
• Vice President of India is the second-highest formal authority after President of India.
 
• **Parliament** is the supreme authority in making laws in India.
 
• **Indian Parliament** comprises of **President, Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha**.
